subject: Request: safety-net credit extension for stalled pilot

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@gridvision.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits expired — request for safety-net extension

Hi Vivek,

Quick note — our sandbox credits for the Redwood pilot expired last week (trial id GV-PILOT-117). We had an internal delay with security onboarding (KYC + internal data access approvals) so the team couldn't run the integration tests. We're still very interested in moving forward, but the environment is currently dead because the credits lapsed.

Is there any way Redwood can temporarily re-provision some credits (or a short extension) so we can finish the last integration smoke tests? Ideally a 30–45 day "safety-net" extension or a one-time 50k-token promo would unblock us. We can provide an updated SOW and confirm procurement details today.

I've attached a short SOC2 excerpt that our security team requested earlier — happy to share whatever else you need.

Thanks,
Sam Torres
Head of Machine Learning, GridVision
[sam.torres@gridvision.ai]

Subject: Re: Pilot credits expired — request for safety-net extension

Sam — thanks for the context and for sending the SOC2 excerpt. I'm sorry you hit the timing issue.

Short answer: yes, we can often provision a short safety-net extension for stalled pilots while security/procurement wraps up. I'll need one of the following to expedite:
- confirmation of the procurement contact + expected sign date, or
- a signed mutual access (MA) or a short purchase order.

What I can offer immediately for approvals is a temporary 30-day extension capped at 50k tokens (non-recurring). If Procurement needs a longer window we can consider a phased credit grant once we have the PO/Master Agreement in flight.

Monica — can you please confirm the steps on your side to apply a one-time promo code and whether we need an internal approval for this account size? Neha — please flag any constraints for promo issuance or deal credits.

Sam — if you can send procurement contact or upload a quick DocuSign link for an MA, I'll push this through our approval queue today.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
